title: BGP-4 is the standards-track specification of the Border Gateway Protocol version 4
summary: BGP-4 is the standards-track specification of the Border Gateway Protocol version 4.
body: RFC 4271 is the standards-track specification titled A Border Gateway Protocol 4 (BGP-4). The source says: "Category: Standards Track January 2006 A Border Gateway Protocol 4 (BGP-4) Status of This Memo This document specifies an Internet standards track protocol for the Internet community, and requests discussion and suggestions for improvements." BGP-4 is an inter-domain routing protocol specified in that RFC. The base specification is not, by its title, a claim that every route advertisement on the public Internet has been authenticated. Authentication mechanisms are separate documents.
